findings.evidence: Lines 15-16 identify invertible fractional ideals with "line bundles / Cartier divisors"; lines 33-37 explicitly say only principal compatibility is proved and the quotient-level isomorphism is not proved.
findings.fix: Rephrase this as the Cartier-divisor/fractional-ideal side of the affine dictionary, and reserve line bundles/Picard language for the later quotient-level comparison.
findings.issue: The module doc says invertible fractional ideals "are the line bundles / Cartier divisors" of the affine curve, conflating Cartier divisors with line bundles even though the file only proves the divisor-level map and later says the quotient-level class/Pic comparison is not proved.

findings.evidence: `rg -n "fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv_apply"` shows the public declaration at lines 147-150 with no preceding `/-- ... -/` docstring.
findings.fix: Add a short docstring explaining that the packaged equivalence evaluates to `fractionalIdealDivisor` on forward application, or make it private if it is only an implementation convenience.
findings.issue: The public simp theorem `fractionalIdealDivisorAddEquiv_apply` has no docstring.

summary: The new file has a module docstring and most declarations are documented, but one public simp theorem is undocumented and the module doc overstates the line-bundle interpretation.
